k:坪.mnemonic: A patch of soil (土) raked flat (平), just big enough to lay two sleeping mats side by side: the unit by which a building plot is measured. Two-mat area (approx. thirty-six sq ft).
k:坪.hint: Raked patch fitting two sleeping mats.

k:渓.mnemonic: No tsunami (氵), just a narrow rush of water that a claw (爪) seems to have scratched down through the soil (土) of the slope. A big (大) person (人) can step across it. Mountain stream (valley).
k:渓.hint: A claw-scratch of water down the slope.

k:薫.mnemonic: Ten thousand (万) flowers (艹) are dried over low flames (灬) all day (日), and the warm smoke carries their scent down the whole valley. Send forth fragrance (fragrant, be scented, smoke).
k:薫.hint: Scented smoke rolling down the valley.

k:尿.mnemonic: A dog visits the flag (尸) pole and leaves its own yellow water (水) at the foot of it, as dogs do. Urine.
k:尿.hint: Dog at the foot of the flagpole.

k:崖.mnemonic: Pressure (圧) deep in the earth pushed one side of the mountain (山) straight up, leaving a sheer wall of layered rock with a long drop below. Cliff (bluff, precipice).
k:崖.hint: Mountainside shoved up into a sheer wall.

k:拭.mnemonic: Before the ceremony (式), fingers (扌) with a cloth go over every cup and tabletop until nothing shows a smear. Wipe (mop, swab).
k:拭.hint: Cloth over every cup before the guests.

k:缶.mnemonic: A lid with a pull-tab pressed down onto an open-topped container, sealed tight to keep the food inside for years. Tin can (container).
k:缶.hint: Pull-tab lid on a sealed container.

k:陶.mnemonic: Clay dug from the mound (阝) is shaped into a jar like a tin can (缶) and laid in the cradle (勹) of the kiln to bake hard. Pottery (porcelain).
k:陶.hint: Clay jar baking in the kiln.

k:需.mnemonic: No rain (雨) for weeks. The farmers shake a rake (而) at the sky and shout for what their fields must have. Demand (request, need, necessary).
k:需.hint: Farmers shaking a rake at the sky.

k:秩.mnemonic: A big (大) person (人) plants grain (禾) in the soil (土) in dead straight lines, one seed every hand-span, never a gap and never a crooked row. Regularity (salary, order).
k:秩.hint: Seeds in dead straight, even rows.

k:伺.mnemonic: The leader (亻) knocks softly at his old teacher's door and asks, 'Can (可) I come in?' He has brought a gift and a question. Pay respects (visit, ask, inquire).
k:伺.hint: A soft knock at the teacher's door.

k:汁.mnemonic: Three drops dripping down on the left, and on the right a cross like a ladle laid over the top of a pot. Soup (juice, broth, sap).
k:汁.hint: Drips beside a ladle on a pot.

k:朽.mnemonic: A book (本) forgotten in an old cradle (勹) in the damp attic: the pages turn brown and crumble to dust when touched. Decay (rot, remain in seclusion).
k:朽.hint: Crumbling pages in an attic cradle.

k:凝.mnemonic: Is the gravy still liquid? There is no doubt (疑) once the icicles (冫) form on the window: it has set stiff in the pan. Congeal (freeze, stiff, be absorbed in).
k:凝.hint: Gravy set stiff in a cold pan.

k:翁.mnemonic: In the public (公) square sits a man with a beard as white and soft as feathers (羽). Everyone who passes stops to bow to him. Venerable old man.

k:愉.mnemonic: You waited a whole month (月), and now (今) the knife (刂) sinks into the birthday cake. Your heartbeat (忄) skips with delight. Pleasure (happy, rejoice).
k:愉.hint: The cake is finally being cut.

k:栽.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) pokes holes in the soil (土) and a young tree (木) goes into each one, row after row across the hillside. Plantation (planting).

k:剖.mnemonic: Stand (立) the melon upright, set the knife (刂) on top, and split it so that every mouth (口) at the table gets an equal piece. Divide.

k:媒.mnemonic: A woman (女) sits under the tree (木) between two quarrelling families, pouring sweet (甘) tea for both sides until they agree to the match. Mediator (go-between).
k:媒.hint: She pours tea for both families.

k:昧.mnemonic: The day (日) is not yet (未) here: in the grey before sunrise you cannot make out shapes or faces at all. Obscure (dark, foolish).

k:穏.mnemonic: The cat draws in its claw (爪), the broom (ヨ) rests against the wall, the grain (禾) stands still in the field, and the heart (心) slows. Calm (quiet, moderation).
k:穏.hint: Sheathed claws, still field, slow pulse.

k:准.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) with icicles (冫) on its tail stands in line among the penguins. It is almost one of them, a sort of half-member. Quasi- (semi-, associate).

k:睡.mnemonic: The eye (目) has counted ten thousand (万) sheep, and the lid hangs a little lower with each one. Drowsy (sleep).
k:睡.hint: Eyelid sinking as sheep go by.

k:酬.mnemonic: The state (州) owes you for mending its bridge, and settles the debt by sending a full wine jar (酉) to your door. Repay (reward, retribution, prize).
k:酬.hint: A full jar for mending the bridge.

k:凄.mnemonic: A woman (女) sweeps the frozen lake at midnight with a broom (ヨ), ten (十) icicles (冫) hanging from her hair, and she leaves no footprints. Uncanny (weird, threatening, horrible).
k:凄.hint: Midnight sweeper who leaves no footprints.

k:逝.mnemonic: The blanket lies on the empty bed with a neat fold (折). Its owner has gone down the path (辶) that nobody comes back along. Departed (die, death, dead).
k:逝.hint: Folded blanket on an empty bed.

k:宛.mnemonic: In the evening (夕), under your own roof (宀), you finish the letter, stick on a stamp (卩), and write where it must go. Address (just like, fortunately).
k:宛.hint: Writing on the envelope at night.

k:苗.mnemonic: Tiny green tips, a long way from being flowers (艹) yet, poke up out of the rice field (田) in spring. Seedling (sapling, shoot).
k:苗.hint: Green tips poking from the paddy.

k:餅.mnemonic: Twenty (廾) pounded white rounds laid out in a row (並) on the New Year tray, soft and stretchy and ready to eat (食). Mochi rice cake.
k:餅.hint: Soft white rounds on a tray.

k:篤.mnemonic: He cares for his horse (馬) so earnestly that he cuts fresh bamboo (竹) for it every dawn and sits up with it through every illness. Fervent (kind, cordial, serious).
k:篤.hint: Sitting up all night with his horse.
